expansion.shift.count-bigint.note: the crate shifts by any non-negative count where the reference refuses a count outside int with SCRIPT_ERR_BIG_INT (a right shift; a left shift by such a count fails the size bound first, SCRIPT_ERR_SCRIPTNUM_OVERFLOW, which the crate meets with a resource abort at its element budget: undecided, #42)
